name: official-registry/io-namefi-mcp
title: Namefi
description: Search, buy, and manage domains, DNS records, orders, and NFSC balance on Namefi.

headers.description: Namefi API key, created at https://namefi.io/api-key. Optional: instead of a key, clients can sign in with OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration), which this server advertises via RFC 9728 metadata on a 401. Every request must be authenticated by one method or the other — there is no anonymous access, including for read-only availability and pricing lookups.
